info.name: WAITER-MVP - Role Workflow
info.description:
Backend verification for the Waiter role MVP. Exercises happy paths a waiter actually uses (login, shift, floor read, reservations read/seat, orders create+send+mark-served+request-bill, receipts read/reprint/send, HR self-scope) plus the negative paths that should now be denied after the seed tightened the role (reservation admin, handoff endpoints, KDS state transitions, cross-waiter order access, shift-gated writes).

Run order:
1. 00 Read Me
2. A. Auth & Context (waiter)
3. B. Shift / Readiness
4. C. Floor / Tables
5. D. Orders
6. E. Reservations
7. F. Receipts
8. G. Me / HR Self-Scope
9. H. Permission Denials / Guard Rails
10. I. Edge Cases / Known Caveats

All folders are [STANDALONE] - the collection-level pre-request resolves waiter token, /api/auth/me context, branchId, orgId, tableId and menuItemId, and folder-level pre-requests resolve folder-specific fixtures (open shift, owner token, owner-owned order, closed receipt, employeeId).

WARNING: Re-import required after any script change. Postman caches pre-request and test scripts at import time. If you previously imported this collection and the scripts have since been updated, delete the collection from Postman and re-import the JSON.

request.description:
## Run order
1. **A. Auth & Context** - waiter password login, /api/auth/me, quick-pin login, refresh, logout
2. **B. Shift / Readiness** - open shift, verify writes succeed
3. **C. Floor / Tables** - list, detail, reserved-table detail
4. **D. Orders** - happy path: create dine-in, add/update/remove items, send (200), mark-served (200), request-bill (200 + idempotent), create takeaway, list filters
5. **E. Reservations** - list, upcoming, detail, seat (200 + table flips OCCUPIED)
6. **F. Receipts** - view, history, reprint, send (202 PENDING - no live adapter)
7. **G. Me / HR Self-Scope** - clock, attendance ?mine=true, leave ?mine=true, create leave, shift-swaps ?mine=true
8. **H. Permission Denials** - cross-waiter order GET (403 ORDER_NOT_OWNED_BY_WAITER), waiter creating reservation (403), confirm/cancel/deposit/assign-table (403), transfer-server/move-items/split-bill/merge (403), in-kitchen/ready/void (403 ORDER_TRANSITION_NOT_WAITER_SAFE), shift-not-open probe
9. **I. Edge Cases** - receipt send PENDING, no combine/uncombine in MVP, reservation admin out of scope

## Variables auto-populated
- `waiterAccessToken`, `waiterRefreshToken`, `waiterUserId`, `accessToken` (alias to waiter) - via collection pre-request
- `orgId`, `branchId` - via /api/auth/me
- `menuItemId`, `tableId` - via first-row resolution
- `ownerAccessToken`, `otherWaiterOrderId`, `receiptId`, `employeeId` - via folder-level pre-requests

## Locked rules verified
- Waiter ownership guard returns 403 ORDER_NOT_OWNED_BY_WAITER
- Waiter state-transition guard returns 403 ORDER_TRANSITION_NOT_WAITER_SAFE for /in-kitchen, /ready
- Reservation admin permissions removed from waiter role
- Handoff endpoints (transfer-server, move-items, split-bill, merge) denied for waiter
- /pos/orders/:id/request-bill returns 200 with billRequested:true and is idempotent
- /receipts/:id/send returns 202 with status:PENDING + supported:false (no live adapter)
- HR ?mine=true filters to actor employeeId

## WARNING
Re-import required after any script change. Postman caches pre-request and test scripts at import time.
